title: cosmos palmeri var. typicus
intro: Cosmos palmeri var. typicus, commonly known as Palmer's cosmos, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Palmer's cosmos include its ability to act as an antioxidant, a sedative, and a diuretic, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Palmer's cosmos include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
